simple_fishing_overhaul.config.catchRadi: Radius in blocks around the bobber in which fish can be caught.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueC: Chance for fish to get intrigued by the bobber and move towards it. The Lure enchantment increases this chance.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueR: Radius around the bobber where fish can become intrigued by it. The Lure enchantment increases this radius.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.lureBonus: How much Lure should affect the intrigue chance and radius.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.castCharg: Allows charging the fishing rod cast to control the distance of the cast.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.minCastDi: Controls the closest distance the cast can reach when charging.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.maxCastDi: Controls the farthest distance the cast can reach when charging.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.fishDropN: Prevents fish which were killed by the player from dropping any loot.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.allowFish: Allows fishing in waters with no fish inside to obtain junk or treasure.
simple_fishing_overhaul.client_config.ca: Displays a casting bar in the hotbar when charging the cast.
simple_fishing_overhaul.client_config.cu: Enables a unique first person animation for charging the cast.
Enables a unique third person animation for charging the cast.
